Grade: Grade 7
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Relationships
Topic 2.5: Diversity and interpersonal relationships

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Diversity and interpersonal relationships, part of People and Relationships in Grade 7 SOCIAL STUDIES.
